correctness.rationale: All nine points and 12 affine lines explicitly generated. A complete exact 1260-incidence acyclic Morse matching leaves critical (1,0,0,11,1,0). A 36-term integral four-cycle pairs primitively with a cochain that annihilates all five-boundaries, forcing zero top attaching degrees and the claimed integral wedge. Four integral boundary witnesses prove trivial top homology action for full generated AGL2(F3); all 432 exact signed Lefschetz traces equal the advertised determinant-twisted augmentation character. Standalone exact checker rerun matched the expected output. No extrapolation beyond the single affine plane.

value.rationale: The 9-point Hesse affine plane is the unique nontrivial order-three affine configuration with four parallel classes, central in finite geometry and transversal theory. Its noncover topology is a mixed-dimensional integral sphere wedge 11S3+S4, and its full 432-element rational character is a natural determinant twist of the point and direction augmentation modules. These are natural exact homotopy and representation invariants, inaccessible from face counts or generic collapsibility bounds; they can guide affine-plane covering-complex comparisons without claiming a uniform general theorem.
